kjv: I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment, and consume thee
mine: if for a single moment I should go up among you, I would consume you
note: The clause rega' echad e'eleh beqirbekha wekhillitikha is hypothetical, explaining why God will not go among them (33:3); KJV reads it as an actual threat.
mehar Chorev "from Mount Horeb" most naturally means from that point on; KJV makes it a location.

kjv: Moses took the tabernacle, and pitched it
mine: Moses used to take the tent and pitch it
note: The verbs in 33:7-11 are frequentative (yiqqach... venatah), describing a regular practice; and ha-ohel is a simple tent, not the tabernacle (mishkan) still to be built.
